title: Rocket Boots
description: Level-up your mobility with these fun new Rocket Boots!
body: # Rocket Boots! --- Ever wanted to gain extra mobility in your Minecraft world? Now you can with Rocket Boots! --- **How to Craft:** All you need is 2 iron ingots, 2 firework rockets, and 2 gunpowder in a crafting table like this: ![Crafting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7c15d70175cf3193421a10f3065e1e1975b1cdfb.png) --- **How to Use:** To use the rocket boots, simply jump, then hold jump to start flying! You will see a Fuel % on your hotbar. This will naturally regenerate quickly, but when you reach 0% your boots will be out of juice and you must wait before using them again. --- Want to try in multiplayer?
